about.title: About Plyskach — mason in Prague
about.bio_p1: I've been in construction for over twenty years — running my own trade as a self-employed mason (OSVČ) since 2004, with earlier years spent working on building sites as an employee. I started out in Brno and since 2015 I've been based in Prague, where I've built up a steady client base. I lead every job personally, from the first site visit to handover.
about.bio_p2: I specialise in masonry — bricklaying, partitions, demolition — together with related trades: tiling, façades with insulation, plaster and decorative finishes (stěrky), for which I also hold dedicated training. I communicate with clients in Czech and Ukrainian.
about.bio_p3: I work with a small group of trusted colleagues and never take on more jobs than I can handle. What we agree on is what gets done.
about.certs_subtitle: I regularly attend training courses run by manufacturers of construction chemicals. Scans of full certificates available on request.
about.certs_footer: Additional credentials and full portfolio available on request.
